description: Union trades laborers sequence for site preparation and material handling: walk the site plan and confirm utility marks, stage materials with mechanical aids first, rig a load with rated slings and agreed signals, confirm trench protection and access before anyone enters, then housekeeping and close-out. Aligned to laborers' training programmes (Laborers' Training Center of Northern California — alignment from the 2026-11-10 industry pass, not a partnership). Simulation only — not certification, not a competent-person designation, not an apprenticeship credential.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4). The 111-hall roster in the SmartCiti.X bundle is an in-repo list; 0 of 111 signed off by a named practitioner — a named hall is not a partner.

objectives: Walk a site plan, confirm utility marks, and name the day's hazards
Stage materials with mechanical aids first — no solo heavy lifts
Rig a load with rated slings and agreed signals
Confirm trench protection and access before entry — never enter an unprotected trench
Close out clean: spoil back from the edge, tools in, day logged

sources: OSHA trenching and excavation topic page (osha.gov/trenching-excavation): protective systems, access and egress, spoil placement, competent-person inspections.
OSHA materials handling topic page (osha.gov/materials-handling): mechanical aids, rigging and safe lifting practice.

stations.title: Site board — site plan, utility marks, hazard survey
Staging yard — rigging, pallets, mechanical aids
Trench edge — protective system, access ladder, spoil pile

steps.action: Walk the site plan: confirm the utility marks and name the day's hazards before any work starts.
Stage the materials: mechanical aids first, team lift for anything hands still have to move.
steps.check: Materials staged; no solo heavy lifts.

steps.action: Rig a load for the hoist: pick rated slings, check the tags, and agree the signals with the operator.
steps.check: Rigging rated and checked; signals agreed.

steps.action: At the trench edge: confirm the protective system is in place and the access ladder is set before anyone enters. Nobody enters an unprotected trench.
steps.check: Protection and access confirmed before entry.

steps.action: Housekeeping and close-out: spoil kept back from the edge, tools put away, and the day logged at the site board.
